**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (sits at/above fallback).**

- **Affiliates:** Section 2.2(a) gives Ono an unconditional right to sublicense the Array Patents/Know-How to its Affiliates (and Section 2.1(b) does the same for the manufacturing licence). No consent or even written notice is required, so the fallback element is exceeded.
- **Successor transfer:** Section 18.9 permits assignment without the other Party's consent to an entity acquiring substantially all the business or assets "whether by merger, acquisition or otherwise", carrying the licences with it.
- **Not revocable at will:** termination is limited to uncured material breach (13.3), insolvency (13.4), or Ono's own election (13.2); on expiry the Section 2.1 licences become fully paid-up, irrevocable, perpetual and royalty-free with sublicensing rights (13.1).
- **Noted, not flagged:** short of preferred, third-party Sublicensees/distributors need Array's consent, although contractor manufacturing on Ono's behalf and Subcontractor performance are expressly permitted.

No redline proposed.
